drivers.text: Management attributes revenue growth to its infrastructure business, citing delivery of 850MW of additional datacenter capacity; cloud revenue up 62% with IaaS up 121% and SaaS up 10%, while software revenue fell 3% as customers migrate to the cloud.
Oracle says AI cloud demand keeps growing faster than supply; it booked more than $30 billion of new AI cloud contracts in Q1 and delivered more than 300,000 GPUs since the end of Q4.

Cloud and software expenses rose mainly on a $2.8 billion increase in infrastructure expenses; segment margin percentage fell (55% vs 60%) as infrastructure costs for OCI growth rose; management expects the trend to continue as data center capacity expands.
Cash capex rose from $8.5 billion to $28.5 billion mainly from data center expansion; funded in part by a completed $20 billion at-the-market equity sale and customer prepayments.
Release states the new contracts have no incremental impact on plans to raise capital, and free cash flow was negative about $5 billion as Oracle invested for OCI growth.

gaps: cloud_segment_op_income: Oracle reports segment margin for the cloud and software business (9,358 vs 7,691, excludes SBC, intangibles amortization and other items), not a segment operating income; no OCI-only profit disclosed in these files.

Oracle no longer shows a 'cloud services and license support' line in this 10-Q; the offerings table gives cloud applications, cloud infrastructure, software license and software support (lines 1037-1040).
capex_guidance: no dollar capex guidance in the 10-Q or earnings release exhibit (only 'higher than fiscal 2026'); any figure given on the call is not in these files.
useful_life_change: no change in estimate of server useful life found in the FY26 10-K (searched change in estimate, extend useful); servers and networking stated at six years.

capex_incl_finance_leases_q: Oracle does not give a combined figure; inputs are capex 28,499 and finance lease cash paid 186 (supplemental line); finance lease principal repayment is not a separate cash flow line in these files.
rpo_total and rpo_next_12m_pct in the 10-Q are split across lines (664 on line 321, 13 on line 325); only the release states RPO on one line.
da_ytd equals da_q (Q1 is fiscal YTD); no separate D&A total beyond depreciation 3,156 plus intangible amortization 202.
